lead: A local's slot is re-pointed in four places in `nvs_ir::lower`, and a rule hooked into `bind_local_value` catches three.
body: `write_back_holder` and `write_back_array` `env.insert` directly, and `foreach (… as inout $v)` re-points the array binding by hand, so a nested `inout` foreach silently left the outer array stale. `grep -n "env.insert(" crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/` is the whole check for any rule phrased "whenever this name is rebound".
